image_description: A low-angle, close-up shot of a red ring binder standing upright on a shelf. The binder is open or viewed from the side, revealing the internal ring mechanism holding several stacks of paper and documents. The spine is visible on the left, and the cover appears to be made of rigid plastic or vinyl with a glossy finish. There are some graphic illustrations on the cover (possibly cartoon characters).

The illustration on the cover appears slightly 'melted' or smeared into the background, lacking sharp edge definition typical of printed media.
The edges of the paper sheets near the metal rings show slight blurring and irregularity, lacking the crisp, straight lines expected of stacked paper.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a binder and not a generic book or box.
To check for edge bleeding between the red cover and the white pages, and ensure the rings are physically connected to the spine.
To rigorously audit the illegible text artifacts observed on the green document and any labels.
To assess the overall sharpness and identify any subtle generative distortions in the lighting or materials.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the green document inside the binder; AI often fails to render small text legibly. Also, verify if the metal rings appear to physically pierce the paper or if they float above it due to depth errors.
